name: cti-sweep
description: Once per local day, runs a background Cyber Threat Intelligence subagent at session start and notifies only for critical or watchlisted findings

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.description: Comma-separated products; a finding naming one of them (whole-token, case-insensitive) raises an alert
watchlist.default: Node.js, Bun, npm, LiteLLM, Claude Code, Anthropic, macOS, Chrome, Docker, GitHub, GitLab, Vercel, Railway, Zeabur, TiDB Cloud, Slack, Atlassian, Jira, Confluence, Figma, Statsig, Sentry, Postman, Homebrew, PyPI, NGINX, WordPress, OpenSSL, OpenSSH, Signal, Tor, Plex, OVHcloud, Bullhorn, Onamae, AOMEI, Next.js, React
